text:
emma-pm: Quick sync item from Acme: they want a single marketplace private-offer that bundles committed cloud spend + per-device hardware rebates. They asked if we can show the effective net price on the SKU page and support pledge-to-rebate mapping.

raj-sales: Sales needs a simple play: a table showing commit -> marketplace credit % -> device rebate $ -> estimated net price. Also need a field script for renewal questions.

mike-pricing: Important: decide whether credits are gross (customer sees full discount) or net (after marketplace fees). I recommend gross so it's clearer in UX, but partner settlement must account for fees. Also propose 6 month expiry for marketplace credits, 9 months for device rebates.

olivia-legal: Legal flags: cap total rebate per account per year, require device proof (serials/manifest), include clawback for false claims (12 months), and an audit right. We also need to avoid language promising automatic extension on renewal.

devin-partnereng: Integration notes: checkout-applied credits require SKU wiring and entitlement flags. If we can't do checkout in time, fallback is post-bill rebate (reconciliation). Checkout path is preferred by field. Estimate 4 sprints for full checkout support across regions; canary NA first.

acme-liaison: Acme prefers checkout application and can provide serial feeds for rebates. They can also cap co-fund per quarter.

emma-pm: Proposed flow: (1) Starter tier = 10% marketplace credit + $75/device rebate; (2) Growth = 20% + $200; (3) Enterprise = 30% + custom rebate (manual approval). Gate Enterprise to partner ops & legal.

raj-sales: Please add an "example math" calc for 3 ARR scenarios. Sales 1-pager please.

mike-pricing: I'll translate % to SKU credit amounts and verify floor (min 12% net to Redwood after fees & rebates).

olivia-legal: I'll draft the appendix language and send EOD.

devin-partnereng: I'll open GH tickets for SKU wiring and partner reporting.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Acme bundle: commit+rebate go/no-go" Wed 11:00 PT, 30m. Calendar invites sent.
